items.title: Hackers Can Exfiltrate Windows Secrets and Credentials Silently by Evading EDR Detection
items.description: A method to silently exfiltrate Windows secrets and credentials, evading detection from most Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions. This technique allows attackers who have gained an initial foothold on a Windows machine to harvest credentials for lateral movement across a network without triggering common security alerts.
